# java-complexity

A fixture for `analyze/`'s Java adapter (TODO.md 1.3): `sumOfPrimes` and `getWords` are the worked
examples of SonarSource's cognitive complexity paper (7 and 1); every other method exercises one rule,
its expected values worked by hand in `test/evaluator/analyze/JavaAdapterTest.java`. `Broken.java`
does not parse.
